desc: Identify that \(f(L,R)\) equals the number of maximal consecutive runs in the distinct values of the subarray.
Derive the incremental formula for the sum of component counts over all starts when appending \(x=A_R\), including duplicate handling via the previous occurrence of \(x\).
Express and prove neighbor merge contributions through last occurrences of \(x-1\) and \(x+1\), with safe value boundaries.
Implement the linear scan using 64-bit accumulation and validate it against brute force and samples.
